title: Albumin–globulin coupling does not establish incremental continuous CRP prediction beyond flexible routine measures across NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed centered albumin×globulin feature was tested for continuous log CRP prediction in adults aged≥20. Source NHANES2007–08(n5160) models transferred without target fitting to separately sampled2009–10(n5534). Beyond flexible albumin,globulin,WBC,age,BMI,creatinine,sex,race/ethnicity and smoking,the weighted MSE reduction was 0.00061303 log-unit²;500 joint source-refit/target-resample PSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.00140462,0.00266518]. Adding flexible albumin/globulin ratio and total protein to the comparator reversed the gain. This complements a closely related thresholded-CRP SCI study;it is not a new biomarker or evidence of equivalence. Independent health-system validation remains unavailable.
